paper.title_en: A Nonsingular Logarithmic Bouncing Cosmology in $f(R,T)$ Gravity with Thermodynamic Viability
paper.abstract_en: We present a nonsingular bouncing cosmological model in the framework of modified $f(R,T)$ gravity within a spatially flat Friedmann--Robertson--Walker universe. A logarithmic time-dependent scale factor is assumed to realize a smooth transition from a contracting phase to an expanding phase without encountering an initial singularity. Based on this assumption, the dynamical evolution of the Hubble parameter, deceleration parameter, energy density, and pressure is obtained for various choices of the model and the matter--geometry coupling parameter to confirm the occurrence of a successful bounce. The effective equation of state parameter is examined to characterize the cosmic fluid during different evolutionary phases. The violation of energy conditions, necessary for the realization of the bouncing behavior, is also discussed. The stability of the model is investigated using the squared speed of sound and is found to remain positive within the allowed parameter space, indicating classical stability. Furthermore, constraints on the matter--geometry coupling parameter are obtained by demanding positive energy density, negative pressure, and a viable cosmological evolution. The obtained cosmological constraint on the coupling parameter is also shown to be compatible with the currently available compact-object constraints. The thermodynamic behavior of the model is examined by testing the generalized second law of thermodynamics. The total entropy production rate remains negative during the contracting phase and changes its sign to positive during the expanding phase. However, it becomes singular at the bouncing point, reflecting the breakdown of the standard thermodynamic description during the transition phase.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究f(R,T)引力中的非奇异性反弹宇宙学，并探讨其热力学可行性。它属于广义相对论基础范畴，与黑洞热力学相关，提供了详细的分析和方法。
decision.title_zh: 具有热力学可行性的$f(R,T)$引力中的非奇异对数反弹宇宙学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在修正的$f(R,T)$引力框架内，在空间平坦的Friedmann--Robertson--Walker宇宙中提出了一个非奇异的反弹宇宙学模型。假设一个对数时间相关尺度因子，以实现从收缩阶段到膨胀阶段的平滑过渡，而不会遇到初始奇异性。基于这一假设，我们获得了哈勃参数、减速参数、能量密度和压力在不同模型选择和物质-几何耦合参数下的动力学演化，以确认成功反弹的发生。我们检查了有效状态方程参数，以表征不同演化阶段期间的宇宙流体。我们还讨论了能量条件的违反，这是实现反弹行为所必需的。我们使用声速平方来研究模型的稳定性，并发现它在允许的参数空间内保持为正，表明经典稳定性。此外，通过要求正能量密度、负压力以及可行的宇宙学演化，我们获得了对物质-几何耦合参数的限制。所获得的耦合参数的宇宙学约束也被证明与当前可用的致密天体约束兼容。我们通过检验广义热力学第二定律来检查模型的热力学行为。总熵产生率在收缩阶段保持为负，并在膨胀阶段变为正。然而，它在反弹点处变为奇异，反映了在过渡期间标准热力学描述的崩溃。
